content.body:
MISSIONS
/AUTOLEADER ON|OFF: Enabled by default each time you start the game. When enabled, you will be considered for automatic promotion to mission leader should your current leader leave the mission. /MLIST: Shows a list of all players on the same mission. An asterisk (*) indicates that a player is spawned into the game world. /TAKELEAD: If your mission leader has been inactive for 6 or more minutes, this command allows you to take over leadership of the mission.
MISSION LEADERS
/BACKUPLEADER (PLAYER): Assigns a player to be given leadership in case you leave the mission. If you do not assign a backupleader, the system will choose a player who has leadership promotion enabled (see /autoleader). Counts as activity against "/takelead". Note: backup leader's can /takelead at any time. /MAKELEADER (PLAYER): Hands over leadership of your mission to the named player (must be on your mission). /ORDERS (TEXT): Sets the current orders for your mission which plays a sound on each member's computer and is displayed at the top of their screen. Counts as activity against /takelead. /ORDERS CLEAR: Removes the current orders.
